title: District Commission must direct opposite party to respond
description: The District Commission must direct the opposite party to give their version of the case within a specified period

content.what: must direct the opposite party to give their version of the case
conditions: complaint admitted under sub-section (2) of section 36
complaint relates to goods or services where procedure specified in sub-section (2) cannot be followed
limitations: period of thirty days or extended period not exceeding fifteen days

user_queries: how long does the opposite party have to respond
